verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes implementation-relevant production constraints requiring actual footage and prohibiting avatars and static-image animation for the video ad.
The freelancer explicitly identifies a material conflict between the client's actual-footage requirement and the proposed AI-generated scene workflow.
The client establishes a concrete visual acceptance condition: the rendered video must feel real and not be immediately recognizable as AI-generated.
First concrete failure of visual realism: the client observed that the executed 22-second preview felt unreal and was immediately identifiable as AI-generated.
